title: Claim Yours
description: A way to claim chunks and  protect claims from being changed by other players.
body: Claim Yours lets players protect land by claiming chunks (16x16 areas) so only the owner and trusted friends can build there. * Claim your current chunk with /claim * Unclaim your current chunk with /unclaim * View claim details with /claiminfo * Trust a friend with /claim trust <player> * Remove trust with /claim untrust <player> * Show a visible claim border wall for 10 seconds with /claim show **What protection includes** * Prevents non-trusted players from breaking or using blocks in your claim * Prevents liquid griefing (like placing/pouring buckets into claims) * Prevents harming/interacting with entities in protected claims, including projectile damage from players **Extra notes** * Claims and trust settings are saved per world * /claiminfo shows owner and trusted player names **Tip** use F3+G to toggle chunk borders (vanilla minecraft feature)   THIS MOD IS STILL IN PROGRESS!!!
